verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single line saying founders can 'check when to expect your letter from HMRC about your registration' for employer registration. This suggests HMRC publishes some timing information for that transaction, but the evidence shows neither the times themselves nor equivalent information for other transaction types. Missing for 10: actual published processing-time figures, coverage across transaction types (VAT, Corporation Tax, MTD sign-up), evidence the times are kept current, and independent corroboration.
